title: Release image pack for Quickstart: changelog callouts and before/after UI assets
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Produce a modular image pack for the upcoming Quickstart/Onboarding release notes and blog: high-fidelity feature callouts, composable before/after UI screenshots, and metadata for marketing and docs. Images will be used in the changelog, release blog, console release notes, and social posts. Focus on consistent system styling, scalable export sizes, and accessibility-friendly annotations.
goals: Create 12 final PNG/JPG exports (various aspect ratios) and SVG callouts for feature highlights
Provide before/after composites that clearly depict UX changes to the Quickstart flow
Deliver annotated source frames and a short usage guide for Marketing/Docs teams
Ensure exports meet accessibility contrast and alt-text requirements
deliverables: Figma file: Quickstart Release - Image Pack (master frames + components)
SVG feature callout components (arrow, label, badge) with tokenized colors
A one-page usage guide (MD) with recommended alt text and captions
JIRA/Linear-friendly folder in Drive with final assets and source files
visual_specs: Callouts use Redwood brand accent #3 with 3px rounded rectangle, 14px label text (Inter), 16px badge when needed
Before shots show original Quickstart modal + steps, After shots show updated progressive onboarding and 'Try sample prompt' CTA
Cross-cut overlay to indicate changed elements (30% opacity overlay on deprecated area)
Export guidelines: sRGB, no color profiles embedded; PNG for UI screenshots, optimized JPG for hero imagery
accessibility_notes: All text in callouts >= 4.5:1 contrast ratio against background; adjust accent if necessary
Provide plain-language alt text in a single CSV manifest included with exports
Avoid using color alone to indicate change; combine callout label + icon
Include keyboard focus representation in one variant for screen-reader demos
tasks: Audit Quickstart UI to capture current screenshots (ENG assist)
Create initial Figma frames: before, after, callout components
Iterate per feedback and prepare final exports
Deliver asset package to Marketing + Docs and update Confluence changelog entry
